categories.main_business_segments: The company is a high-tech enterprise specializing in automotive interior components research, development, production and sales. Main products include interior functional components (such as air conditioning vents, cup holders, storage boxes, door handles) and decorative components (door panels, dashboard panels, decorative strips). The company operates as an integrated solution provider covering product design, mold development and manufacturing, component molding, surface coating, appearance wrapping and product assembly.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies including injection molding, spray coating, wrapping, and embedded molding processes. Key innovations include automated injection systems with mechanical arms for automatic feeding and cutting, ABB robotic spray coating for surface treatment, and fully automated assembly equipment. The company has accumulated comprehensive process capabilities across injection molding, blow molding, and embedded molding. Advanced manufacturing techniques include DFMA (Design for Manufacturing and Assembly) methodology and self-developed V3.0 automation systems covering the full production process.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include major Chinese automakers (Great Wall Motors, BYD), global automotive component suppliers (Marelli, Yanfeng, Faurecia, Daikyonishikawa), and international customers in North America and Europe. The company serves both traditional fuel vehicle and new energy vehicle markets, with new energy vehicle-related products generating significant revenue. End markets include passenger vehicles across economy, mid-range, and luxury segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates domestically across six major automotive industrial clusters with production bases in Wuhu, Dalian, Chongqing, Tianjin, Wuhan, and Foshan. Internationally, the company has established operations in Mexico (serving North America), Japan, and Hong Kong. In 2023, domestic interior components revenue was 770.23 million yuan (81.06% of total) while overseas revenue was 107.75 million yuan (11.34% of total).
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the automotive supply chain as a Tier-1 and Tier-2 component supplier. It directly supplies major OEMs (original equipment manufacturers) and also supplies through global Tier-1 suppliers like Marelli and Yanfeng. The company handles the complete value chain from design and mold development through manufacturing and assembly of interior components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) expanding new energy vehicle interior component offerings; (2) developing smart and lightweight products aligned with automotive electrification, intelligence and connectivity trends; (3) advancing automation and intelligent manufacturing capabilities; (4) expanding global market presence, particularly in North America; (5) developing innovative products like electric cup holders, hidden air vents, and smart surface components. R&D investment reached 58.11 million yuan in 2023 (6.12% of revenue), with 255 R&D personnel.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of automotive interior components to OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of goods, typically upon customer signature/receipt or export documentation. The company operates on a make-to-order basis with framework agreements and monthly purchase forecasts from customers. Additional revenue comes from mold sales and engineering services. In 2023, 100% of revenue came from direct sales of automotive interior components.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with both international suppliers (Marelli, Yanfeng, Faurecia, Daikyonishikawa) and domestic competitors. The company differentiates through: (1) comprehensive process capabilities across multiple manufacturing techniques; (2) strong automation and lean manufacturing capabilities developed through long-term Japanese customer relationships; (3) broad geographic production footprint enabling just-in-time supply; (4) advanced design and engineering capabilities; (5) high-quality standards meeting IATF16949 certification. The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier with growing international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of 950.24 million yuan (37.06% growth vs 2022), net profit of 84.15 million yuan (7.29% decline vs 2022), and operating cash flow of 119.92 million yuan. Total assets reached 1.83 billion yuan (98.09% increase from 2022), with shareholders' equity of 1.23 billion yuan (174.30% increase). The company completed IPO in September 2023, raising 691.23 million yuan in net proceeds. The company demonstrates strong growth trajectory with expanding asset base and production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's competitive advantages include: (1) comprehensive integrated solutions from design through assembly, reducing customer development costs; (2) superior automation and manufacturing efficiency reducing production costs and improving quality; (3) extensive experience with Japanese OEMs ensuring high quality and reliability standards; (4) broad geographic footprint enabling responsive local supply; (5) continuous innovation in lightweight, smart, and sustainable interior components; (6) strong technical capabilities in DFMA methodology and advanced manufacturing processes; (7) proven ability to support customers across traditional and new energy vehicle platforms.
